note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, one for each of the 23 divisions, polled on Thursday 5 June 1930 in Portglenone only. Nominations were received on 7 May 1930 (Ballymena Observer, 9 May 1930, p. 10): twenty divisions had one nominee each, Ahoghill and Portglenone two, and Tullaghgarley none, its sitting member, Samuel M'Millen, being deemed re-elected. In Ahoghill the sitting member withdrew and A. C. Logan was declared elected (Ballymena Observer, 23 May 1930, p. 9). No party labels are printed. The nomination list prints the new member as Alexr. C. Logan. Returned unopposed.
